subject: SOC 2 Type II evidence packet and secure onboarding plan for Apex Health
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Blake <security@apexhealth.com>, Apex Health Procurement <procure@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 & secure onboarding next steps

Hi Morgan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side so procurement and security have a clear path: 

- SOC 2 Type II: Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II report for the calendar year 2026 that we can share under NDA. I’ve attached a short bridge letter that summarizes scope and controls while you ingest the full report. (Attachment: SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2026-bridge-letter.pdf)
- Evidence packet / portal: We use a secure evidence locker (invite link below) for sharing artifacts and answering DSQ items. I’ll provision Apex Health access for your security team once you confirm the primary security contact.
- Vendor security questionnaire (DSQ): I’ve attached our DSQ template and can populate the first pass for you; if you prefer, your team can complete it directly. (Attachment: Redwood_DSQ_ApexHealth.xlsx)
- HIPAA / GDPR: Redwood supports data processing agreements for HIPAA-covered deployments and has GDPR-compliant controls; we can provide specifics in the DSQ and the SOC 2 mapping.
- Proposed timeline: If we can get the DSQ and a list of systems you need covered by 9/24 EOD, we’ll prioritize the evidence handoff and schedule a 30-min intake call on 9/27 to walk the engineer through any technical evidence. 

Next steps for Apex Health (suggested):
1) Confirm primary security contact (name + email).
2) Confirm whether you need a temporary attestation/bridge earlier for procurement.
3) Let me know preferred time windows for a 30-min intake call next week.

Portal invite (will send after you confirm contact): https://secure.redwood.com/trustlocker/invite?token=abc123

Thanks — looping in Priyom (compliance lead) to own the DSQ pickup.

Best,
David Kim
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

David —

Appreciate the recap. A few clarifying items from our side: 

1) Primary security contact will be me (Morgan Blake). Please provision to this address.
2) Procurement would like the bridge letter as soon as possible — we have an internal approval window closing 9/28 and would prefer the bridge letter by 9/23 morning if possible.
3) A couple of quick compliance questions we need covered in the DSQ:
   - Does Redwood sign a BAA and operate as a HIPAA business associate for covered workloads?
   - Please confirm retention and deletion controls (we have a 7-year retention requirement for some records).
   - Does Redwood have a Data Processing Addendum for GDPR customers?

We’ll have the procurement lead (procure@apexhealth.com) flag any contractual items, but security will own the DSQ. Can you also tell us what evidence types you typically provide in the locker (policy docs, auth logs, config snapshots, SOC 2 mapping)?

Thanks — if you can provision the portal and share the DSQ, I’ll route to the security team for completion.

—Morgan

On Tue, Sep 21, 2027 at 2:32 PM David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Morgan —
> 
> Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side so procurement and security have a clear path:

Hi Morgan — thanks for the quick turnaround and the questions. Short answers up front, details below: 

- BAA / HIPAA: We do support BAAs for customers processing PHI. Our legal team has a standard BAA template; happy to share a copy with procurement.
- GDPR: We have a DPA and can provide the standard DPA language and processing details in the DSQ.
- Retention: We expose configurable retention controls; for long-term retention we support customer-managed retention policies and can provide a controls mapping in the evidence packet.

What we’ll hand over in the evidence locker (typical):
- SOC 2 Type II report (under NDA) and the one-page bridge letter (attached).
- Control mappings: how our controls map to DSQ and common regs (HIPAA/GDPR).
- Sample policies: InfoSec policy, access control, change management.
- Operational artifacts: anonymized log samples, backup/restore checklist, incident response runbook excerpts (where applicable).

I’ve attached the DSQ template for Apex Health to our reply (Redwood_DSQ_ApexHealth.xlsx). If you’d like, Priyom can do a first-pass answer to reduce your lift; Priyom, can you confirm availability for a 30-min intake?

Regarding the bridge letter timing: we can get the bridge letter to procurement by 9/23 morning if you confirm procurement’s delivery address and whether an NDA is needed beforehand.

Portal: I’ll provision the secure evidence locker for Morgan and the procurement mailbox as soon as Morgan confirms. The invite URL will come from secure@redwood.com.

Proposed intake call times (PT): Thu 9/23 10:00–10:30, Thu 9/23 14:00–14:30, Fri 9/24 09:00–09:30. Please confirm a slot and we’ll calendar it.

Thanks —
David Kim
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
